$description: EDH Seer's type, extracted from the shipped stylesheet. TWO FACES AND NO SERIF: Inter for sentences, JetBrains Mono for data. The file previously carried a Major Third scale and a serif stack; neither renders anywhere in this product, and the real steps below are not a ratio scale - they are the sizes the app sets, several of them half-steps a ratio would not produce.

mono.$description: THE DATA FACE. A distinct face for data is what separates it from the sentences describing it - the stylesheet's own 'standings-desk' framing. Used by eyebrow, pip, stat-num and .tok.

fontSize.$description: The steps index.css actually sets, in px. No 48/60/72 display sizes: this app's largest type is 32px, on one h1, on one page.

2xs.$description: 0.625rem - chart axis labels ONLY; the documented micro step

xs.$description: 0.6875rem - eyebrow and the back link; mono, uppercase, tracked out

md.$description: 0.8125rem - .tok, a model key set inside a sentence

3xl.$description: 2rem - the prose h1. The ONLY display-sized type in the product; at 2.13x the 15px body it sits under the 2.5x bar the component rules set.

none.$description: pip - a digit centred in a circle

relaxed.$description: the prose page - longest measure, loosest leading

tight.$description: headings; the only negative tracking in the system

widest.$description: eyebrow and the back link - uppercase mono needs the air

measure.$description: Line length, held per surface rather than globally: the prose page reads long-form, the footer reads in a column.

textStyle.$description: The composite styles index.css defines by name. Each is a real class in the shipped stylesheet, not a proposal.

eyebrow.$description: .eyebrow - the section label. Lives in Tailwind's `components` layer so a utility class can override its colour; written unlayered it silently beat every `text-(--...)` a caller passed.

pip.$description: .pip - THE ONE RECURRING SIGNATURE. Every numeric score, count or tally renders inside this circle, echoing a standings-board rank marker. `tabular-nums` lives in the class, not at the call site, because every pip is a number by definition and a per-caller utility was silently missing on some.

stat-num.$description: .stat-num - THE ONE FACE FOR EVERY STATISTIC (owner ruling, 2026-08-21). Anything that is itself the fact a row exists to report renders here. Sets ONLY family and alignment: size, weight and colour stay the caller's utilities. NOT for a number merely named inside a sentence - switching faces mid-sentence reads worse than the inconsistency it fixes.

display.$description: .prose h1 - the one h1 on the one prose page.

body-app.$description: .intro - the static explainer under the app, on the same measure as `main` so it cannot read as a different site.

lead.$description: .prose-lead - the standfirst, and the only paragraph that gets the foreground colour.

code-inline.$description: .tok - a name from the data model (`enters`, `token-generation`, `+2/+0`) set inside a sentence. Not a code block.
